Definition: middle voice from G4314 and G4160; to do forward for oneself, i.e. pretend (as if about to do a thing):--make as though.
BiblicalUsage: Prospoieomai means to make as though, to pretend, to act as if about to do a thing. It appears once, on the road to Emmaus: they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went, and He made as though He would have gone further.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that He made as though He would go on because He waits to be asked in: the disciples constrained Him, saying, Abide with us, and He went in to tarry with them.
